summary: Release agent proxy token refresh fails during Vault bulk rotation causing CI jobs to hang
description: Issue summary: During a coordinated Vault KV bulk rotate (scheduled maintenance) several release pipelines stalled with long-running 'auth refresh' waits from the release agent sidecar proxy. Impact: multiple nightly and release pipelines (team-release/*) hung for 20-45 minutes, blocking 3 release windows and delaying Canary rollouts. Scope: ~12 runner pods across two node pools; only pods with the sidecar proxy enabled and with Vault rewrap enabled were impacted. Timeline: 2026-03-01 01:12 UTC - Vault rotate started; 01:19 UTC - first CI API timeout observed; 01:20-02:05 UTC - multiple builds stuck with no agent logs updating; 02:18 UTC - temporary mitigation applied (sidecar restart) and some jobs recovered. Expected behavior: sidecar should gracefully refresh tokens and retry with backoff without stalling the main agent or failing in-flight pipelines.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger a Vault KV bulk rewrap/rotate in prod using the standard rotate job (performed at 01:12 UTC)
2) Ensure release-agent pods have sidecar proxy with VAULT_REWRAP=enabled and short-lived tokens (TTL ~5m)
3) Observe sidecar attempting auth refresh: sidecar logs show 401 -> rewrap -> transient decrypt failures -> blocking call to agent until restart
4) Confirm that restarting the sidecar unblocks the agent and job resumes without job-level retry logic kicking in
logs: [release-agent-sidecar] 2026-03-01T01:18:57Z WARN auth: token refresh attempt failed: transit/decrypt: ciphertext not found
[release-agent-proxy] 2026-03-01T01:19:02Z ERROR backoff: refresh loop stuck waiting for 'key-unwrap' (attempt=7, sleeping=30s)
[agent] 2026-03-01T01:21:11Z INFO heartbeat: heartbeats stopped; last task_id=rel-20260301-378
[kubelet] 2026-03-01T02:05:14Z INFO pod/runner-xyz sidecar restarted by liveness-probe
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: Vault rewrap affected transit keys causing sidecar decrypt to return 404/KeyNotFound for short-lived tokens
Observed: not all pods were impacted; pattern correlated with node pools that had recent OS patches (kubelet 1.28.2) and slightly delayed Vault agent rolling restart
Repro attempt in staging: reproduced by forcing rewrap + blocking KMS availability for 30s; sidecar entered a synchronous refresh path that blocked agent main thread

Found race: sidecar's auth refresh is implemented as a synchronous blocking call with exponential backoff up to 5m and no circuit-breaker; if transit decrypt returns 'ciphertext not found' repeatedly, it does not fallback to short-lived retry token generation path
comments: Support (Aisha): Escalated to SRE at 01:40 UTC after multiple pipelines reported >10m stalls. Notified #release-ops and #sre on-call.
SRE (Diego): Confirmed sidecar logs show repeated transit/decrypt 404s coincident with Vault rotate window. Will try interleaved restarts to validate mitigation.
Eng (Priya Patel): Suggested a hotfix to change sidecar refresh to async with cancellable context so agent isn't blocked by decrypt loops. Will open PR for quick rollback and test in staging.
SRE (Diego): Applied temporary mitigation 02:12 UTC - rolling restart of affected sidecars; pipelines resumed. Collecting postmortem data and traces.
resolution: Mitigation applied: rolling restart of sidecar proxies unblocked agents and allowed pipelines to complete. Short-term code workaround merged (sidecar-proxy PR #122): switch auth refresh to asynchronous non-blocking path with bounded retry and fallback to token re-request endpoint. Follow-ups: 1) Release a patched sidecar-proxy image (v1.7.3) and orchestrate controlled rollout across all node pools; 2) Update secret-rotation runbook to include targetted sidecar rolling strategy and pre-check for KMS/transit availability; 3) Add health-check endpoint to detect 'stuck refresh' and trigger liveness restart earlier; 4) Postmortem to be authored and linked to incident record.
